description: Det skal anskaffes arbeidsbord for manuelt arbeid i uren, ren og steril sone i sterilsentralen ved Nye Aker Sykehus. Anskaffelsen omfatter 23 arbeidsbord, med tilleggsutstyr/tilbehør.Anskaffelsen er delt inn i følgende tre delkontrakter:Delkontrakt 1: Vaskebord til sterilsentralDelkontrakt 2: Kontroll og pakkebord til sterilsentralDelkontrakt 3: Arbeidsstasjon for sterilsveisFor ytterligere informasjon om omfang og innhold vises det til Bilag A-G i konkurranse-grunnlagets del II. Tilbydere bes lese hele konkurransegrunnlaget samlet for utarbeidelse av tilbud.

title: 26237 Prosjektleder til anskaffelse og implementering av Sak-Arkivløsning
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av prosjektleder og et prosjektteam for å lede et felles prosjekt som har samordne og definere behov, lage en behovsbeskrivelse og implementere løsning for en ny sak og arkiv løsning for deltakerne. Fasene i Prosjektveiviseren skal ligge til grunn for prosjektet. Følgende deltakere vil inngå i samarbeidet om prosjektet: Gjøvik kommune (org. 941 574 431) IKT Valdres (995 607 409) * Nord-Aurdal kommune * Sør-Aurdal kommune * Vang kommune * Etnedal kommune * Øystre Slidre kommune * Vestre Slidre kommune SÅTE-samarbeidet (Trysil kommune vertskommune:864 948 502) * Stor-Elvdal kommune * Åmot kommune * Trysil kommune (vertskommune) * Engerdal kommune Opsjon: Vestre Toten kommune (org. 971 028 300) Nordre Land kommune (org. 861 381 722) Søndre Land kommune (org. 961 381 630) Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til over EØS terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene. Oppdragsgiver tar forbehold om avlysning av konkurransen, blant annet i forbindelse med budsjettmessig dekning.

title: Rammeavtale for renholdsmaskiner
description: Bakgrunn Telemark fylkeskommune ønsker å etablere en helhetlig og fremtidsrettet rammeavtale for renholdsmaskiner til videregående skoler, tannklinikker og øvrige fylkeskommunale bygg. Dagens maskinpark består av ulike maskintyper og fabrikater, og anskaffelser har i stor grad vært gjennomført som enkeltkjøp. En felles rammeavtale skal bidra til mer effektive anskaffelser, forutsigbare betingelser, enklere kontraktsoppfølging og bedre tilgang til service, reservedeler og teknisk support. Rammeavtalen skal dekke både tradisjonelle og autonome renholdsmaskiner. Fylkeskommunen ønsker å legge til rette for effektiv ressursbruk, økt automatisering og hensiktsmessig standardisering, samtidig som ulike lokasjoner kan velge løsninger tilpasset sine behov. Ved valg av løsninger skal det legges vekt på funksjonalitet, driftssikkerhet, klima- og miljøhensyn og samlede kostnader gjennom levetiden. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder etablering av en rammeavtale for levering av tradisjonelle og autonome renholdsmaskiner med tilhørende utstyr og tjenester til Telemark fylkeskommune. Rammeavtalen skal blant annet omfatte: Gulvvaskemaskiner og kombimaskiner, herunder kompakte og fleksible løsninger for mindre arealer. Batteridrevne støvsugere og øvrige relevante støvsugere. Tepperensere, dampmaskiner og High Speed-maskiner for gulvvedlikehold. Autonome renholdsmaskiner og robotløsninger, inkludert løsninger for automatisering av eksisterende maskiner. Moppvaskemaskiner og moppekjøleskap. Tilbehør, børster, pads, slitedeler, reservedeler og maskintilpasset forbruksmateriell. Rammeavtalen omfatter kjøp av alle obligatoriske maskinkategorier og funksjonsleie som alternativ for de autonome kategoriene som er angitt i prisskjemaet. Ordinær leie omfattes ikke. Funksjonsleie innebærer at oppdragsgiver betaler et månedlig vederlag for avtalt funksjon fremfor å eie maskinen. Ordningen gjelder utvalgte autonome renholdsmaskiner og inkluderer nødvendig utstyr, programvare, opplæring, service, vedlikehold og driftsoppfølging. Nærmere innhold og vilkår fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen og avtaledokumentene. Leverandøren skal kunne levere nødvendig utstyr og tjenester for sikker og stabil drift gjennom avtaleperioden. Dette omfatter blant annet batterier, reservedeler, programvareoppdateringer, dokumentasjon, opplæring og teknisk bistand. For autonome løsninger skal det legges til rette for sikker navigasjon, hensiktsmessig digital styring og rapportering samt forsvarlig behandling av data og personopplysninger. Rammeavtalen inngås med én leverandør for en periode på to år, med opsjon på forlengelse i ytterligere ett år + ett år. Oppdragsgiver foretar avrop etter faktisk behov og tilgjengelige budsjettrammer. Oppgitte mengder er estimater og innebærer ingen kjøpsforpliktelse.

title: Rammeavtale for byggevarer, verktøy og tilhørende forbruksmateriell
description: IFE NUK skal gjennom denne anskaffelsen inngå en rammeavtale for kjøp av byggevarer, verktøy og tilhørende forbruksmateriell. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre Kundens behov for byggevarer, verktøy og tilhørende forbruksmateriell på en kostnadseffektiv måte, samtidig som hensyn til miljø og samfunnsansvar ivaretas. Rammeavtalen skal bidra til en forutsigbar, effektiv og brukervennlig leveranse av varer til Kundens lokasjoner på Kjeller.

title: Rehabilitering av vei, vann og avløp fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 55 på Norefjord
description: Bakgrunn Nore og Uvdal kommune skal rehabilitere vei, vann- og avløpsanlegg på strekningen fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 33 på Norefjord. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres fordi eksisterende ledningsnett og vei er nedslitt, og dagens standard ikke i tilstrekkelig grad ivaretar driftssikkerhet, fremkommelighet og en langsiktig, kostnadseffektiv forvaltning. Formålet er å etablere en robust og varig infrastruktur for vei, vann, avløp og overvann på den aktuelle strekningen. Kommunen ønsker å redusere risikoen for driftsforstyrrelser, bedre adkomsten for beboere og utrykningskjøretøy og legge til rette for enklere vedlikehold i årene fremover. For leverandører er det viktig å være kjent med at prosjektet skal gjennomføres i et område der trafikkavvikling, adkomst for berørte eiendommer og koordinering med kommunal VA-drift vil være sentrale forhold. Gjennomføringen må derfor planlegges slik at nødvendige tjenester opprettholdes og ulempene for omgivelsene begrenses i anleggsperioden. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en utførelsesentreprise for rehabilitering av vei, vann- og avløpsanlegg på strekningen fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 55 på Norefjord. Oppdraget omfatter i hovedsak etablering eller utskifting av vann- og avløpsledninger med tilhørende kummer og nødvendige løsninger for overvannshåndtering. Videre omfatter oppdraget oppbygging og rehabilitering av vei med nytt dekke, samt tilhørende arbeider som er nødvendige for å ferdigstille en helhetlig og funksjonell løsning innenfor prosjektområdet. Leveransen skal også omfatte nødvendige tiltak for sikker og forsvarlig gjennomføring i anleggsperioden, herunder håndtering av trafikk og adkomst, samt koordinert utførelse som ivaretar berørte innbyggere og eksisterende infrastruktur. Det forventes en komplett leveranse i samsvar med konkurransegrunnlaget, med vekt på kvalitet, fremdrift og en løsning som gir varig funksjon og driftssikkerhet.

title: Maritime sikkerhetskurs for Fagskolen i Nord og Ishavsbyen vgs
description: Bakgrunn Fagskolen i Nord, maritim avdeling, og Ishavsbyen videregående skole har et løpende behov for eksterne maritime sikkerhetskurs for elever og studenter. Kursene er nødvendige for å oppfylle gjeldende STCW-krav og for å sikre at deltakerne får sertifikatgivende sikkerhetsopplæring som inngår i skolens utdanningstilbud. Behovet omfatter både planlagt opplæring for hele klasser og mulighet for bestilling av kursplasser til enkeltelever og enkeltstudenter ved behov. Antall deltakere og sammensetningen av grupper kan variere fra år til år, og oppdragsgiver har derfor behov for en leverandør som kan tilby forutsigbar og fleksibel gjennomføring innenfor avtalte perioder. Det er videre viktig for oppdragsgiver at kursene gjennomføres med høy faglig kvalitet, nødvendige myndighetsgodkjenninger og et dokumentert kvalitetssystem i tråd med krav fra sjøfartsmyndighetene. Leverandøren må også kunne legge til rette for en trygg og effektiv gjennomføring, herunder hensiktsmessig koordinering med skolene og nødvendig logistikk ved eventuelle reiser og opphold i forbindelse med kurs. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget gjelder levering av eksterne maritime sikkerhetskurs til Fagskolen i Nord, studiested Tromsø, og Ishavsbyen videregående skole i perioden 2027 og 2028, med opsjon på forlengelse i inntil ytterligere to år. Anskaffelsen omfatter grunnleggende sikkerhetskurs, videregående sikkerhetskurs, kurs i medisinsk behandling og livbåtførerkurs i henhold til relevante STCW-bestemmelser. Leveransen skal omfatte kursgjennomføring for hele klasser og, ved behov, enkeltplasser for elever og studenter. Oppdraget omfatter også tilhørende planlegging og koordinering knyttet til gjennomføring, herunder praktisk tilrettelegging for deltakere, samt håndtering av oppfølging ved behov for ny prøve eller fullføring av manglende kursdeler. Oppdragsgiver etterspør en leveranse med høy kvalitet, tydelige bestillings- og gjennomføringsrutiner og god fleksibilitet ved endringer i deltakergrunnlaget. Kursene skal tilbys innenfor oppdragsgivers ønskede tidsperioder, og leverandøren må kunne sikre en helhetlig og forsvarlig gjennomføring som er tilpasset skolens behov. Omfanget som er angitt nedenfor er estimert og ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. Oppgitte volum er basert på forventet behov per år, og faktisk uttak kan variere i avtaleperioden. Oppdragsgiver vil bestille kurs i henhold til det til enhver tid gjeldende behov. For Ishavsbyen videregående skole forventes følgende gjennomføring i 2027: Grunnleggende sikkerhetskurs STCW A-VI/1: Inntil 5 videregående skoleklasser (VG2 maritime fag og VG3 skipselektriker), med opptil 75 deltakere totalt. Kursgjennomføring forventes innenfor uke 36 til og med uke 42 i 2027. Kurs skal bestilles minimum 8 uker før aktuell kursstart. Livbåtfører, i samsvar med STCW regel VI/2, tabell A-VI/2-1: 2–3 klasser innen maritime fag (VG2 fordypning matros), med opptil 45 deltakere totalt. Kursgjennomføring forventes innenfor uke 15 til og med uke 19 i 2027. Kurs bestilles av oppdragsgiver minimum 8 uker før aktuell kursstart. Det kan i tillegg bli aktuelt for inntil 15 elever på VG3 skipselektrikere å ta videregående sikkerhetsopplæring STCW A-VI/3. Det er ikke med i verdiestimat eller prisskjema. For Fagskolen i Nord forventes følgende gjennomføring: Videregående sikkerhetskurs STCW A-VI/3: 2 klasser ved maritim fagskole (dekksoffiser- og maskinoffiserklasser), med opptil 48 deltakere totalt. Kurs bestilles av oppdragsgiver minimum 8 uker før aktuell kursstart og forventes gjennomført i vårhalvåret. Medisinsk behandling: 1 dekksoffisersklasse ved maritim fagskole, med opptil 24 deltakere totalt. Kurs bestilles av oppdragsgiver minimum 8 uker før aktuell kursstart og skal gjennomføres i vårhalvåret. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å justere antall deltakere, antall klasser og tidspunkt for gjennomføring innenfor rammene av avtalen. Leverandøren skal ha kapasitet og fleksibilitet til å håndtere slike endringer, samt tilrettelegge for eventuelle enkeltbestillinger ved behov. Skolen har ikke egnede lokaler for gjennomføring av kurs slik at all kursing må foregå hos leverandør eller på andre egnede lokasjoner.

title: 26252 Billettkontroll
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av billettkontrolltjenester. Anskaffelsens årlige verdi anslås til: NOK 1.300.000,- eks. mva og er dermed over EØS terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene

title: Anskaffelse av regnskapstjenester med opsjon av lønnstjenester
description: Trondheim Renholdsverk AS, heretter kalt Oppdragsgiver, inviterer til å gi tilbud på levering av regnskapstjenester.Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå avtale med en ekstern leverandør som kan levere effektive, sikre og faglig robuste regnskapstjenester, samt bidra med nødvendig regnskaps, skatte og avgiftsfaglig rådgivning. Lønnstjenester inngår som en opsjon i avtalen.

title: Innkjøp møbler nye Mosjøen vgs
description: Nordland Fylkeskommune skal i forbindelse med etablering av nytt Fellesbygg for videregående skole på Kippermoen i Mosjøen, møblere skolebygget.Det nye skolebygget i Mosjøen skal samle dagens tre videregående skolene i ett nytt fellesbygg.Se for øvrig vedlagte dokumenter

title: Konkurranse - C07094 - Konsulentbistand til NATO Security Investment Programme - Oslo - 200105
description: Forsvarsbygg, avdeling prosjekt og utvikling ønsker tilbud på én (1) konsulent til å bistå inn i NATO-kontoret i seksjon tidligfase.Omfang: Forventet stillingsprosent er ca. 50-75 % stilling i ett år, med opsjon på forlengelse av bistanden i to år, i perioder på inntil ett år av gangen. Forsvarsbygg vil ikke kreve noe mer enn 50 % bistand, men godtar inntil 75 %. Utløsing av opsjon(er) krever samtykke fra leverandør.Arbeidssted er Forsvarsbyggs kontorlokasjon i Oslo, Grev Wedels plass 5. Reisekostnader og reisetid i forbindelse med oppmøte, dekkes ikke.Sikkerhet: Leverandørens konsulent må kunne sikkerhetsklareres til nivå Hemmelig/Nato Secret (H/NS). Manglende klarering er tentativt ikke til hinder for oppstart, men Forsvarsbygg forbeholder seg retten til å forskyve oppstart eller redusere omfanget inntil sikkerhetsklarering er på plass.Frister: Det anbefales å stille eventuelle spørsmål innen tidsfrist for å stille spørsmål, samt å merke seg som "ønsker å tilby" innen samme frist. Disse fristene er veiledende. Tilbudsfristen er derimot absolutt.Følgende oppgaver må påregnes, men er ikke nødvendigvis begrenset til:Koordinere og følge opp tildelte NATO Security Investment Programme-/NSIP-prosjekter.Utarbeide søknader til NATO.Bistå og rådgi intern i FB og eksternt i sektoren innenfor NSIP-området. Forberede og delta på NSIP-inspeksjoner.Bidra til å identifisere og utvikle nye NSIP-prosjekter.Vennligst se konkurransegrunnlaget for nærmere beskrivelser av behovet.

title: Kjøp av helelektrisk ADR skapbil - VKR
description: Kontrakten gjelder kjøp av 1 stk. helelektrisk ADR skapbil med ca. 18 pallplasser.Det skal også gis tilbud på 7-års service- og reparasjonsavtaler på bilen, samt mindre tilleggsleveranser som opsjoner.

title: Rammeavtale for energimerking, energikartlegging og energivurdering dOslo
description: Statsbygg ber om tilbud på rammeavtale for: energimerking, energikartlegging og energivurdering av tekniske anlegg. Statsbygg skal inngå en rammeavtale med én leverandør for driftsområde Oslo

title: Prekvalifisering - anskaffelse av Bistand til drift- og vedlikehold av AIS-service manager system
description: Kystverket vil inngå avtale med en leverandør for bistand for vedlikehold og drift av AIS Norway, Helcom Regional Server og Northsea Regional Server med krav til oppetid, basert på nasjonale og internasjonale krav, på 99,6% pr. år.Avtalen skal dekke behov for løpende assistanse for å holde AIS distribusjonssystem - AIS Norway, inkludert to Regionale servere som heter Helcom (alle land som grenser til Østersjøen) og Northsea (land som ligger i Nord Europa fra Island - Frankrike) (EU -system) i operativ drift. Løsningen er bygd på standarden ITU-R M.1371-5.Mer informasjon om AIS Norway finnes her: https://www.kystverket.no/en/sea-transport-and-ports/ais/ais-norge/Kystverket ønsker en leverandør som kan:gi bistand til å vedlikeholde og drifte/hoste AIS Service manager system – AIS Norway og utvikle den etter Kundens behov;bistå Kunden i å ivareta eventuelle offentlige krav ‒ inkludert krav om personvern/GDPRvære en innovativ og proaktiv rådgiver i utviklingen av brukervennlig funksjonalitet, digitalisering, API’er mv.nødvendige lisenser inngår i anskaffelsen

title: 2026 IKT- Konsulenttjenester digital formidling – design, utvikling og rådgiving
description: Nasjonalbiblioteket ønsker å inngå rammeavtale for utviklings-, design og rådgivnings-tjenester på eksisterende og nye digitale formidlingstjenester.

title: Rammeavtale for pakketekniske løsninger til Felleskjøkkenet
description: Bakgrunn Oppdragsgiver har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale for pakketekniske løsninger til Felleskjøkkenet. Anskaffelsen er begrunnet i et utskiftingsbehov, da eksisterende maskinpark er utdatert og ikke i tilstrekkelig grad ivaretar dagens krav til drift, hygiene, sikkerhet og effektivitet. Felleskjøkkenet produserer og pakker daglig både varme og kalde måltider, med kontinuerlig drift og flere operatører fordelt på ulike skift. Det er derfor behov for løsninger som sikrer stabil produksjon, trygg bruk og effektiv ressursutnyttelse. Anskaffelsen skal også bidra til redusert energiforbruk og lavere driftskostnader over tid. Andre enheter og kommunale foretak kan ved behov benytte rammeavtalen. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder etablering av en rammeavtale for kjøp av pakketekniske løsninger til Felleskjøkkenet, inkludert tilhørende utstyr og tjenester som er nødvendige for å sikre en velfungerende drift. Leveransen skal dekke behovet for maskiner til pakking og forsegling av måltider, tilpasset storkjøkkenets produksjonsvolum og varierende kapasitetsbehov. Det etterspørres driftssikre, brukervennlige og energieffektive maskiner med hygienisk utforming som legger til rette for enkel rengjøring. Løsningene skal kunne håndtere ulike pakningsstørrelser, være egnet for daglig produksjon og opprettholde stabil ytelse ved produksjonstopper og skiftbytter. Rammeavtalen skal omfatte nødvendige tjenester knyttet til levering, installasjon og bruk av maskinene, herunder igangkjøring, testing, opplæring, dokumentasjon, validering, HMS-dokumentasjon, service og feilretting. Det skal også kunne leveres reservedeler og relevant forbruksmateriell i avtaleperioden. Alle varer og tjenester som leveres, skal være i samsvar med gjeldende standarder og regelverk.

title: 26282 Juridiske tjenester, rammeavtale
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av juridiske tjenester. Anslått verdi per år og maksimalverdi for hele avtaleperioden per delkontrakt, inkludert eventuelle opsjoner og forventet prisstigning er oppgitt i punkt 1.4. Behovet er usikkert. Volumet kan variere både opp og ned, og vil i avtaleperioden være avhengig av blant annet oppdragsgivers behov, aktiviteter, budsjettsituasjon og andre rammefaktorer. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene.

title: Konkurranse - totalentreprise aerotempere for Vikingskipet
description: Kort om anskaffelsen Anskaffelsen omfatter utskifting og fornyelse av varmeanlegget i Vikingskipet grunnet redusert varmeavgivelse til hallen etter oppgradering til LED arenabelysning. Leveransen skal omfatte prosjektering, levering, montering, innregulering, idriftsettelse og dokumentasjon av nye aerotempere i hallareal med tilhørende rørarbeider, reguleringsutstyr og automasjon. Dagens anlegg er basert på 6 stk. aerotempere, og oppvarmingseffekt skal økes gjennom bytte av varmelegemer (aerotempere) og utskifting av tilhørende ledningsnett. Dagens fjernvarmeveksler er opplyst å ha tilstrekkelig kapasitet til å dekke Vikingskipets varmeeffektbehov etter at brannstasjonen skilles ut med egen kundesentral. Tilbyder skal likevel verifisere eksisterende kapasitet og beskrive nødvendige tiltak for å sikre tilfredsstillende drift av det nye anlegget. Tiltaket følger anbefalingene i Norconsults energikartlegging og rapport om oppvarming av Vikingskipet, og skal bidra til energieffektiv oppvarming samt opprettholdelse av ønskede temperaturforhold ved ordinær drift, arrangementer og større mesterskap. Oppdragsgiver vil legge ut en tegningspakke med tilgjengelig tegningsunderlag for bygget i Hyyr. 3D-modell (punktsky) av Vikingskipet kan utleveres etter forespørsel via Hyyr. Beskrivelse av leveransen følger av øvrige vedlegg. Forbehold om finansiering Det gjøres oppmerksom på at det er vedtatt finansiering av prosjektet basert på tilskudd fra Kultur- og likestillingsdepartementet (KUD). Hvis det viser seg at tilbudte priser ligger over budsjett, vil man måtte fremlegge en ny sak om tilleggsfinansiering. Hvis dette ikke vedtas, vil konkurransen måtte avlyses. Deltakerne i konkurransen har ikke krav på erstatning for kostnader til å utarbeide tilbud og andre kostnader som deltakerne er påført som følge av konkurransen. Befaring Oppdragsgiver vil gjennomføre en felles anbudsbefaring der de som ønsker det kan delta, eventuelt sammen med sine konsulenter/rådgivere og underentreprenører. Befaringen vil finne sted med oppmøte utenfor hovedinngang til Vikingskipet 26. november kl. 12.00 Kontraktsbetingelser Norsk standard NS 8407:2011 «Alminnelige kontraktsbestemmelser for totalentreprise» skal gjelde for denne kontrakten, med de endringene og tillegg som følger anbudsdokumentene, særskilt del II - Kontraktsgrunnlag. Krav til innlevering Tilbudet skal besvares konkurranseverktøyets angitte felter. Dokumenter opplastes på angitte steder. Følgende dokumenter legges ved tilbudet, hvor det bes om at tilbudet er organisert som følger: Tilbudsbrev med tilbudssum. Eventuelt utfylling av vedlegg om forbehold og avvik jfr. Punkt 2.2

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [AI-as-OS] Artificial Intelligence as Operating System
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods have been expanding into new areas of application for years. AI systems are increasingly capable of handling complex tasks with greater autonomy—for example, through agent-based approaches that run an AI agent on a computer to perform any task automatically or even autonomously, sometimes without explicit human instructions but rather based on identified intentions (see, for example, the open-source software OpenClaw, which can handle tasks such as calendar maintenance or file management). Just how deeply AI algorithms and models are now integrated into everyday applications is also evident in the fact that end devices are increasingly operable entirely without visible applications and exclusively via voice control, which fundamentally rethinks the way we interact with them (such as Deutsche Telekom’s AI Phone). The central control units of such end devices—the operating systems themselves—are also increasingly being enhanced with new AI functionalities to continuously improve system efficiency. These include initial theoretical—and in some cases already practical—approaches to using the latest AI technologies for file system or storage management. These developments mark a fundamental paradigm shift: AI is no longer viewed merely as an add-on, but increasingly as a native architectural component of the operating system itself. The AI-as-OS program aims to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood not merely as a separately encapsulated functionality that is simply executed by the operating system, but as the operating system itself—Artificial Intelligence as Operating System. Behind this lies the vision of an AI that not only supports individual applications but also acts as the central control system for the entire computer ecosystem, managing system resources (including the CPU, RAM, and system security) in a data-driven, adaptive, and context-aware manner. The aim of the program is to make fundamental contributions to the development of AI-based operating systems as the control unit of a computer system. Through the extensive integration of AI technologies into deep operating system layers, such a system is intended to manage system resources, enable context-aware operational decisions, and enhance system security through adaptive threat detection and defense. Since the underlying technology is still largely in a speculative stage, the scope of development work ranges from the general architecture of such an operating system to the integration of AI-based core mechanisms, and includes new considerations regarding the security and stability requirements for such an operating system, depending on the target platform (e.g., desktop, data center, edge device) and the application environment. The program’s main areas of research include: • AI-Centric Operating System Architectures: Concepts for the fundamental design of an operating system in which AI is viewed not as an add-on feature but as an integral part of the architecture. • AI-Native Core Mechanisms: Integration of AI-based methods into core operating system functions such as resource management, process control, and memory organization. • Control, Security, and Stability: Requirements for traceability, controllability, and robustness of an AI-based operating system, as well as approaches to adaptive threat detection and defense. From today’s perspective, it remains to be seen whether—and to what extent—the vision of an AI-native operating system can be technically realized. This is precisely where the program’s value lies: AI-as-OS explores a largely speculative field at the intersection of AI research and system software, the results of which could set the course for the operating systems of tomorrow.

title: France – Engineering services – Maitrise d'oeuvre relative à la rénovation énergétique du garage atelier métro ligne A de Chantepie
description: Le contrat comporte des tranches optionnelles définies au cahier des charges. Le détail des missions confiées au titulaire figure au programme prévisionnel. Les prestations sont réglées par des prix forfaitaires. Le garage atelier du métro de Chantepie, situé route de Vern, héberge à la fois des activités industrielles (exploitation des lignes A et B de métro via le Poste de Commande Centralisé et maintenance des rames ligne A) et tertiaires (services transverses de Keolis Rennes Métropole). Il a été mis en service en 2002 lors du lancement de la ligne A et a fait l'objet d'une extension en 2011 à l'occasion du projet d'augmentation de capacité de cette même ligne. Aucun programme de rénovation énergétique d'envergure n'a été mené depuis la mise en service du site au début des années 2000 : il est donc exploité avec les technologies et performances de l'époque. Dans une optique de réduction et de maitrise des dépenses liés à la consommation énergétique, des audits ont été menés en 2023-2024 sur ce site par la société ALTEREA. Ces audits ont permis de dresser une liste des solutions d'amélioration efficaces et rentables à courts, moyens et longs termes (investissements, gains énergétiques, confort, etc.). Chacune de ces modifications était justifiée en chiffrant l'investissement nécessaire et en présentant les gains énergétiques espérés. L'opération consiste en une réhabilitation de bâtiment au sens de la loi MOP. Elle nécessitera de mener les études puis effectuer les travaux de rénovation du bâtiment principal (atelier) du site dénommé &quot;garage atelier Chantepie&quot; (GATC) de la ligne A en vue d'améliorer sa performance énergétique. Les différentes compétences mobilisées sur cette opération sont les suivantes : - Études MOE dans le cadre de la loi MOP (AVP/PRO/ACT/VISA/EXE/DET/AOR/OPC) - Renforcement des structures de l'atelier, - Modernisation du système de chauffage, - Isolation, - Modernisation de la ventilation, - Installation de panneaux photovoltaïque pour de l'autoconsommation Ces compétences ne présument en rien l'allotissement pressenti des travaux qui sera déterminé en phase AVP

È inoltre obbligatorio garantire una quota adeguata di alimenti biologici, a filiera corta, a ridotto impatto ambientale e prodotti specifici per celiaci. Il contratto rientra nei settori ordinari (servizi sociali, categoria alberghieri e ristorazione) ed è identificato dal codice CPV 55523100-3 e dal codice ATECO 2025 56.22.02. title: UHV Großer Graben - Planungsleistungen Goldbach M2 u. M5
description: Das Land Sachsen-Anhalt hat sich nach § 54 Wassergesetz für das Land Sachsen-Anhalt vom 16. März 2011 (GVBI. LSA S. 492) (WG LSA), zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 21 des Gesetzes vom 7. Juli 2020 (GVBI. LSA S. 372, 374) zur Umsetzung der Wasserrahmenrichtlinie verpflichtet. An den Gewässern 2. Ordnung übernehmen die Unterhaltungsverbände (UHV) die Aufgabe des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt, die für die Erreichung der Zielstellungen der WRRL notwendigen Vorhaben umsetzen. Das Land Sachsen-Anhalt erstattet dem jeweiligen UHV nach Maßgabe der Richtlinie über die Gewährung von Zuwendungen zur Förderung von Vorhaben der naturnahen Gewässerentwicklung zur Umsetzung der Wasserrahmenrichtlinie im Rahmen des GAP-Strategieplans (Richtlinie Umsetzung WRRL GAP-SP) die dabei entstehenden Ausgaben. Aus dem GAP-Strategieplan für die Bundesrepublik Deutschland werden Investitionen zur naturnahen Gewässerentwicklung einschließlich konzeptioneller Vorarbeiten und Erhebungen (u.a. Erstellung von Gewässerentwicklungskonzepten) sowie Grunderwerb (Art. 73 der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/2115) mit Mitteln des Europäischen Landwirtschaftsfonds zur Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums (ELER) und des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt gefördert. Im Rahmen dieses Programms beteiligt sich der ELER mit bis zu 80 v. H. an den kofinanzierungsfähigen öffentlichen Ausgaben. Gefördert werden insbesondere Vorhaben zum Schutz und zur naturnahen Entwicklung der Gewässer durch die Verbesserung der Hydromorphologie im Gewässer einschließlich Ufer und Sohle sowie des unmittelbaren Gewässerumfelds. Diese sollen der Abmilderung der negativen Auswirkungen anthropogener Eingriffe und Einflüsse auf den Zustand der Oberflächengewässer als Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums zur Anpassung an die Folgen des Klimawandels, für nachhaltiges Wasserressourcenmanagement und nachhaltige Gewässerbewirtschaftung dienen. In diesem Sinne sollen nachhaltige Maßnahmen zum Schutz und zur Entwicklung von Gewässern und zur Stärkung der Regulationsfähigkeit des Landschaftswasserhaushaltes umgesetzt werden. Es wird eine Verbesserung der Gewässerstruktur und der Gewässerqualität sowie die gezielte Steigerung und die Inanspruchnahme der Speicherfunktion der Landschaft zum Wasserrückhalt auch zur Anpassung an die Folgen des Klimawandels und zur Umsetzung der Ziele der Wasserrahmenrichtlinie angestrebt. Im Verbandsgebiet des Unterhaltungsverbandes "Großer Graben" sind in den Gemarkungen Beckendorf-Neindorf und Hornhausen (weitere) Maßnahmen zur Revitalisierung des Hornhäuser Goldbachs (Gewässer II. Ordnung) vorgesehen. Grundlage bildet eine bereits vorliegende Machbarkeitsstudie, auf deren Basis in vorangegangenen Förderperioden bereits verschiedene Maßnahmen zur Revitalisierung des Gewässers sowie zur Herstellung der ökologischen Durchgängigkeit umgesetzt wurden. Die genaue Beschreibung entnehmen Sie bitte der Leistungsbeschreibung C.1.

description: The Department of National Defence (DND) has a requirement for the services of a ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA) to provide technical architecture expertise and leadership in support of a Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) onboarding initiative. The resource will support the design, validation, and implementation of a secure, scalable, and sustainable ServiceNow Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) solution, while providing architectural leadership across the broader HRSD platform to ensure HR services and capabilities are designed and implemented within a cohesive enterprise architecture. The objective of this requirement is to provide technical architecture leadership for DND's ServiceNow HRSD platform, including the CAF onboarding initiative and related HR service delivery capabilities. The resource will define and maintain the target architecture, ensure alignment with departmental standards and ServiceNow leading practices, establish secure integration and data management approaches, and provide technical oversight to ensure that HR capabilities are implemented as a cohesive, scalable, and sustainable enterprise solution supporting both military and civilian business requirements.

title: ICT-koulutukset
description: Hankinnan kohteena on ICT-koulutuspalvelut Helsingin kaupungin ja Helsingin Konsernihankinta Oy:n ilmoittautuneiden osakkaiden käyttöön. Nämä ovat DigiHelsinki Oy (3300938-6), Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (2379058-6), Helsingin Kaupunkitilat Oy (3226884-5), Helsingin Seniorisäätiö (1729947-5) ja Helsinki Partners Oy (3209009-8). Hankinta jakautuu kolmeen osa-alueeseen. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely seuraaville osa-alueille: Osa-alue 1 / Taso 1: Peruskäyttäjä, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. Osa-alue 2 / Taso 2A, Peruskäyttäjä, Taso 2B, Tehokäyttäjä ja Taso 2C, Ammattilainen, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. Osa-alue 3 / Taso 3, Asiantuntija, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. ICT-koulutuksilla tarkoitetaan tässä hankinnassa tieto- ja viestintäteknologiaan, digitaalisiin työvälineisiin, ohjelmistoihin, tietoturvaan, data-analytiikkaan, tekoälyyn sekä tietojärjestelmien käyttöön ja kehittämiseen liittyviä koulutuksia, valmennuksia ja työpajoja Tarjouksen voi jättää yhdelle tai useammalle osa-alueelle. Jokaiselle osa-alueelle tehdään erilliset valinnat. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on kolme (3) miljoonaa euroa (alv 0%). Arvioitu arvo sisältää koko sopimuskauden eli neljä (4) vuotta ja sen arvioidaan jakautuvan osa-alueittain seuraavasti: osa-alue 1: 800 000 euroa osa-alue 2: 1 100 000 euroa osa-alue 3: 1 100 000 euroa. Tilaaja ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. title: Painelaitevalvonnan hankinta
description: Painelaitevalvonnan hankinta Hankinnan kohteena on CSC – Tieteen tietotekniikan keskus Oy:n (myöhemmin "CSC" tai "Tilaaja") konesalien painelaitteiden valvonta. Valvonta suoritetaan CSC:n Kajaanin konesalien tiloissa, jotka sijaitsevat Kajaanissa Renforsin Rannan yritysalueella osoitteessa Tehdaskatu 15, RATA-rakennus, 87100 Kajaani. CSC:llä on Kajaanissa kaksi datakeskusta, EuroHPC ja LUMI AI datakeskukset. EuroHPC datakeskus on aloittanut toimintansa vuonna 2021 ja LUMI AI valmistuu arviolta kesällä 2027. Painelaitteiden valvontapalvelu otetaan siten aluksi käyttöön EuroHPC konesaliin ja se laajennetaan kattamaan LUMI AI datakeskus sen valmistuttua. EuroHPC konesalin painelaitteiden määrä ja laatu ilmenee liitteestä 3 jonka Tarjoaja saa allekirjoitetun turvallisuussopimuksen vastineeksi (tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön kohdassa Menettelyn lisätiedot). LAIFDC konesalissa painelaitteita tulee olemaan arviolta noin 27 kappaletta. Määrä on arvio ja se voi muuttua sopimuskauden aikana.,

title: Belgium – Filing equipment – Aménagement des espaces de stockage du futur Heritage Center de la SNCB à Schaerbeek, afin d’assurer la conservation adéquate de diverses collections patrimoniales : rayonnages, meubles à tiroirs, ainsi que rayonnages pour textiles et tableaux
description: La conservation, la gestion et la mise à disposition des collections patrimoniales de la SNCB font partie de sa mission de service public. Dans ce cadre, le Service Documentation et Archives, actuellement établi rue de France 85 à 1060 Bruxelles, sera transféré vers le nouveau Heritage Center, situé place Princesse Élisabeth 7 à 1030 Schaerbeek. Le présent marché porte sur la fourniture et l’installation d’un système de stockage modulaire et flexible destiné aux nouveaux espaces de dépôt, comprenant des rayonnages d’archives, des meubles à tiroirs ainsi que des rayonnages pour tableaux et textiles. Le système de stockage doit permettre une utilisation optimale de l’espace disponible, être adapté à la conservation durable et sécurisée des collections patrimoniales concernées et pouvoir être adapté aux futurs besoins de stockage. Sur la base de l’étude de capacité réalisée par la SNCB, les besoins sont estimés à environ 4 300 mètres linéaires de tablettes, 3 meubles à tiroirs et une surface utile totale d’accrochage de 80 m² pour les rayonnages destinés aux tableaux et aux textiles. Les quantités mentionnées sont indicatives. Le déménagement des collections ne fait pas partie du présent marché.

title: NHSGGC Provision of Breastfeeding Support Services
description: NHS GGC recognises the important contribution that third-sector organisations can make through the provision of breastfeeding peer support. Peer support offers families access to people with relevant lived experience who can provide practical, social and emotional support, complementing the clinical and professional support provided by NHS services. The service will contribute to the implementation of the Scottish Government Breastfeeding and Infant Feeding Strategic Framework and NHS GGC's Infant Feeding Policy and will support the delivery and sustainability of UNICEF UK Baby Friendly standards. The successful provider will work in partnership with NHS GGC, Health and Social Care Partnerships (HSCPs), maternity, neonatal, health visiting, Family Nurse Partnership (FNP) and other relevant services to provide an integrated breastfeeding support offer across NHS GGC. The service will follow and develop the existing model of community breastfeeding peer support, including the delivery of breastfeeding/infant-feeding support groups, recruitment and training of peer volunteers and targeted engagement with communities experiencing inequalities.

title: Illumina and PacBio Sequencing of Human and Mouse DNA and RNA
description: The Mechanistic Studies Division (MSD) of Health Canada’s Environmental Health Research and Science Bureau investigates the pathways by which physical, chemical and microbiological agents can cause adverse health effects. To determine how chemical substances cause DNA damage that can lead to illnesses like cancer or inherited diseases, MSD requires high-throughput genome sequencing services utilizing Illumina and Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) platforms. The primary objective of this contract is to secure long-term high-quality sequencing services for pre-prepared DNA libraries and genomic DNA and/or RNA utilizing Illumina or PacBio Revio platforms for the full duration of projects funded until up to 2030-2031. This requirement encompasses the sequencing of multiple mouse and human error-corrected next-generation sequencing (ecNGS) DNA libraries, genomic DNA and/or RNA samples in direct support of four distinct research projects. These projects are distributed across the Division and funded through three separate programs. Collectively, they employ advanced genomic technologies to support public health protection by identifying environmental mutagens, evaluating occupational hazards, and improving toxicological testing methodologies. Specifically, this work will use ecNGS, whole-genome sequencing (WGS), whole-exome sequencing and/or RNA-sequencing approaches to detect and characterize both spontaneous mutations and mutations induced by chemical and environmental exposures in mouse and human DNA as well as gene expression changes. The resulting data will contribute to a better understanding of mutagenic mechanisms, exposure-related genetic damage, and the development of more sensitive and informative approaches for genetic toxicology and human health risk assessment.

title: Emergency Medical Evacuation Services
description: Global Affairs Canada is seeking to establish a contract for the provision of emergency medical evacuation and support services on a worldwide basis, twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week (i.e., 24/7) for Canadian government employees and their dependants assigned to Canada's missions abroad. Global Affairs Canada through its FSD Services and Policy Bureau is mandated to provide client oriented advice and administration of the Foreign Service Directives to all Canadian government employees and their dependants who are assigned to Canada's missions abroad and who are subject to the provisions of the Foreign Service Directives. Employees serving outside Canada are required to have comprehensive coverage under the Public Service Health Care Plan (PSHCP) for themselves and their dependants to ensure that they have sufficient health care coverage. As a result, standard health care coverage for employees and their dependants does not form part of the Department's service requirement. However, the PSHCP does not provide coverage for medical emergency evacuations and case management services. Therefore, the Department will require a Contractor to provide these services. The Contractor will provide a range of medical emergency evacuation and case management services on a worldwide, 24/7, basis including emergency medical evacuation, medical call centre services, medical case consultations and management, referrals, and health care travel consultations to employees and their dependants at all Canadian diplomatic missions and posts outside of Canada. The contractor’s services must be available in both Official Languages of Canada (English and French).

title: Enabling Technology for Future Missions
description: SPACE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM BACKGROUND The Space Technology Development Program (STDP) mandate is to formulate, implement and manage contracted out research and development (R&D) projects in response to identified needs. Its objectives are to develop and demonstrate strategic technologies that have a strong potential for reducing technical uncertainties for future Canadian space activities. The STDP will therefore support the development of technologies to meet the current and future needs of the Canadian Space Program. OBJECTIVES The objective of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to enable the development of Space Technologies that are in line with the Canadian Space Agency’s (CSA) priorities and mission roadmaps. For the Priority Technology (PT) specified herein (see APPENDIX A-5 of ANNEX A), the work solicited is the development and advancement of the technology (Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)), (see APPENDIX A-1 of ANNEX A) to reduce technical uncertainties and support approval and implementation of specific potential future space missions of interest to Canada.

description: Yhteisöllisen asuminen, kevyt ja tuetun asumisen palvelut, osa-alue 3: Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva / 1. uudelleen avaus Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Yhteisöllisen asumisen, kevyen ja tuetun asumisen palvelujen hankintamenettelyn 2489/2024 ensimmäiseen uudelleen avaukseen. Uudelleen avaus koskee osa-aluetta 3 Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki tarkoittaa henkilöstön läsnäoloa vuoden jokaisena päivänä palvelukuvauksessa määritellyllä tavalla. Päihteet sallivassa yksikössä päihteiden käyttöä ei varsinaisesti rajoiteta, mutta sen tuottamia haittoja ehkäistään ja vähennetään. Tarvittaessa yksikön henkilökunnan tulee tukea asiakasta kohti päihteettömyyttä. Hankittava palvelu on kuvattu tarkemmin palvelukuvauksessa. Uudelleen avaus koskee hankintamenettelyn osa-aluetta 3. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Uudelleen avauksen osalta hankinnan arvioitu arvonlisäveroton arvo on noin 2 000 000 euroa vuodessa. Arvio on suuntaa-antava eikä sido tilaajaa. Uudelleen avauksessa valitaan halvimman hinnan perusteella kolme (3) uutta yksikköä tuottamaan palvelua. Tilaajan tarve yksiköille painottuu Tampereen alueelle. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valitut kaksi (2) yksikköä jatkavat palvelua perustamisvaiheen hankintasopimusten mukaisesti ja niiden osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan. Kyseisten perustamisvaiheessa valittujen yksiköiden osalta palveluntuottajat voivat kuitenkin jättää tässä uudelleen avauksessa tarjouksen laskeakseen voimassa olevaa hintaa. Palveluntuottajarekisteri päivitetään uusien tarjousten perusteella. Palveluntuottajat luetellaan rekisterissä uuden vertailun mukaisessa sijajärjestyksessä. Hankintamenettelyn avaamisen ja uusien tarjousten myötä myös aiemmin valitun palveluntuottajan vertailun mukainen sijajärjestys saattaa muuttua uuden vertailun perusteella. Hankintamenettelyn uudelleen avauksen yhteydessä hyväksyttyjen palveluntuottajien sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027. Sopimuskausi on voimassa toistaiseksi. Palveluntuottajien on aloitettava palvelutuotanto viimeistään 1.9.2027. Sopimuksen voi irtisanoa hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ilmoitetuin irtisanomisehdoin. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valittujen palveluntuottajien osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan, eikä sopimuskauden pituuteen tule muutoksia tämän uudelleen avauksen myötä. Mahdolliset hinnanmuutokset päivitetään palveluntuottajarekisteriin. Tarjousten valinta- ja vertailuperusteet ovat tarkemmin kuvattuna tarjouspyynnön "Päätöksenteon perusteet"-kohdassa.,

The contractor shall provide all personnel, supervision, management, tools, equipment, materials, supplies, transportation, and other resources required to operate, inspect, test, maintain, repair, and support Government facilities and associated real-property installed equipment. The anticipated requirement includes recurring operations and maintenance, preventive maintenance, unscheduled maintenance, service-order support, minor repairs, specialty-system repairs, materials management, inventory control, technical reporting, quality control, and safety management. Building and Grounds Maintenance Building envelope, doors, foundations, exterior systems, grounds, drainage, and basic infrastructure support Materials Management Procurement, storage, inventory, tracking, accountability, and installation of materials, parts, and spares. The contractor will be responsible for complying with applicable U.S. Government, host-nation, local, safety, environmental, labor, licensing, permitting, insurance, and access-control requirements. 8. Stage 2 - Water Treatment Plant System Upgrade, Riding Mountain National Park
description: REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires a qualified General Contractor to complete construction-phase upgrades to the Water Treatment Plant control system at Riding Mountain National Park. The work includes upgrading the existing Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) systems, together with associated hardware, software, control panels, communications, electrical connections, operator interfaces, and field-device integration. The Construction Contractor will supply and install the required equipment; develop or modify PLC and SCADA programming; integrate the upgraded system with existing plant processes and instrumentation; complete testing, start-up, commissioning, operator training, and closeout documentation; and correct deficiencies. All work must be coordinated with Parks Canada and plant operators to maintain safe and continuous water-treatment operations. Planned shutdowns, system cutovers, and temporary control arrangements require prior approval. TWO STAGE SELECTION PROCESS This posting is the Stage Two of a two-stage solicitation process: the first stage was to evaluate the qualifications of all interested suppliers. The second stage (Stage Two) is to invite the qualified suppliers to provide further qualifications and a financial bid on the project based on the specifications and drawings. Only qualified suppliers have been invited to bid. Potential and interested sub-contractors are invited to add their company’s name under the section “Partner with another business”.

title: Tierpark Bern Dählhölzli, Neu- und Ersatzbauten, 291 Architekturleistungen, Studienauftrag mit 2 Lose
description:
La Ville de Berne gère plusieurs installations zoologiques sous le nom de « Tierpark Bern » (Parc zoologique de Berne). Elle offre à la population des possibilités de détente et des expériences personnelles, transmet et développe des connaissances sur la faune et la flore, et sensibilise le public à la détention des animaux dans le respect de leurs besoins, ainsi qu’à la protection de la nature et des espèces. Le Tierpark Bern comprend notamment les sites du Dählhölzli et du Parc aux ours (Bären Park). Afin de répondre aux besoins d’un nombre croissant de visiteurs et d’assurer une détention des animaux adaptée à leurs besoins, des investissements sont prévus dans les infrastructures et les enclos existants ainsi que dans de nouvelles installations. Par ailleurs, des mesures sont envisagées pour améliorer les conditions de travail du personnel. Parallèlement, le Tierpark Bern entend accorder une attention accrue, à l’avenir, aux défis posés par le changement climatique et la perte de biodiversité. Le périmètre du projet abrite en outre des habitats et des espèces protégés par la Loi fédérale sur la protection de la nature et du paysage (LPN) ; leur préservation, ou une compensation équivalente, doit impérativement être prise en compte lors du développement du projet.


La réalisation de ces objectifs implique des transformations spatiales. Il s’agit de créer de nouvelles installations et de remplacer celles qui sont vétustes. De plus, l’accès au site du Dählhölzli doit être amélioré pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Cette démarche constitue un élément essentiel de la planification globale du Tierpark Bern pour la période 2023–2033, laquelle décrit en détail la vision et la stratégie de ce qui se veut être « le parc zoologique le plus charmant de Suisse ».

title: Renovate Building 1203-DOAS/AHU and Fire Suppression Water System, March Air Reserve Base, California
description: This solicitation is for construction services required for HVAC and Fire Suppression systems repair of Building 1203 at March Air Reserve Base, CA. This is an Invitation For Bid, sealed bid procurement. The solicitation notice will be posted to SAM.gov 4 November 2026 by Close of Business.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Louisville District hereby issues an Invitation for Bid (IFB), Solicitation No. W912QR27BA004, to renovate Building 1203-DOAS/AHU and Fire Suppression Water System, March Air Reserve Base, California. A description of the construction project is as follows:This work consists of, but is not limited to, installing a new Dedicated Outside Air System (DOAS) air handling unit, the replacement of Air Handling Unit (AHU-02) and the replacement of the existing waterline that ties the main waterline to Building 1203. The distance of waterline to be replaced is estimated to be 100-ft. Additional site-work will include a larger housekeeping pad, larger equipment access platform, and larger landscaped enclosure to accommodate the additional DOAS air handling unit. New outside air supply and return ductwork will be incorporated leading from the DOAS unit to the rooms served by AHU-02 providing direct-to-room ventilation. The Contract Duration is 500 calendar days from Administrative Notice to Proceed.TYPE OF CONTRACT AND NAICS: This IFB is intended to result in the award of one Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The North American Industrial Classification System Code (NAICS) for this effort is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction.TYPE OF SET-ASIDE: This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside.DISCUSSIONS: The Government intends to award without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussion should it be deemed in the be interest of the Government.CONSTRUCTION MAGNITUDE: The magnitude of this construction project is anticipated to be between $1 million and $5 million.REGISTRATIONS: Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the following database: System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award. If the Offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity shall have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. If at the time of award an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror. POINT-OF-CONTACT: The point-of-contact for this procurement is Rachael McClellan, Rachael.L.McClellan@usace.army.mil. PARTNERING WITH US: https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve defeminization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/ and then clicking on: View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here.

title: S208--TREE CARE MANAGEMENT SERVICE
description: TREE CARE MANAGEMENT SERVICES The Tomah VA Medical Center Forest has significant historic, health and ecological value. Management and maintenance efforts are aimed at preserving these characteristics, promoting biodiversity, and ensuring the long-term health and safety of the forest ecosystem. The VA is seeking a contractor with the capability and capacity to perform comprehensive tree removal, trimming, tree health management, new tree planting, and long-term forest management planning to preserve the health and ecological value of the forest. A Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials, transportation, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to remove hazardous trees, provide trimming, identify hazards, provide tree health management activities, provide new tree selection and placement, clean up debris, and produce a 5-year forest management plan.

title: Y--Rocky Mountain Region Industry Day
description: Indian Affairs (IA)is pleased to announce the Rocky Mountain Region Industry Day. Indian Affairs gives preference to Indian Economic Enterprises IEEs) and Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs), and is especially interested in attendance by local, Indian-owned small businesses working in the construction sector. Rocky Mountain Region has many small and moderately sized construction projects and we wish to develop our relationship with local ISBEEs who can help us meet these needs. Many of our projects are for roof repair or replacement, HVAC system repair or replacement, and electrical or plumbing work. Specialized contractors are welcome, as well as general contractors. We would also like to help local, Indian-owned small businesses that have not done business with the Federal government or Indian Affairs before to understand the requirements for ISBEE status as well as the general process for obtaining Federal contracts. Local contractors will have their offices located in Montana or Wyoming. This Industry Day will provide businesses with: � Information on upcoming contracting opportunities � Guidance on the Buy Indian Act procurement process � Resources to help businesses successfully compete for federal contracts The event will be attended by Bureau of Indian Affairs Rocky Mountain regional facilities staff and Indian Affairs contracting officers specializing in construction and related services. title: W065--IDIQ Hospital Bed Rental and Maintenance Services for Texas VA Medical Centers
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 17, is conducting market research to identify qualified vendors capable of providing hospital bed rental and maintenance services in support of Veteran care throughout the State of Texas. The information obtained from this RFI will be used to determine the availability of capable sources and assist the Government in acquisition planning for a potential Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. This announcement is for informational and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a solicitation. Requirement Description The VA has a requirement for the rental, delivery, setup, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, repair, replacement, pickup, and related support services for hospital beds used in the care of Veterans at VA Medical Centers, Community Living Centers, Community-Based Outpatient Clinics, and other authorized locations throughout Texas. The anticipated contract will support multiple VA healthcare facilities located within the Texas Veterans Health Care System. Specific performance locations and technical requirements are detailed in the attached Statement of Work (SOW). Services may include, but are not limited to: Rental of standard and specialty hospital beds. Delivery, installation, and setup of hospital beds. Preventive maintenance and inspection services. Corrective maintenance and repair services. Emergency repair and replacement services. Removal and pickup of equipment. Compliance with all applicable Federal, State, Joint Commission, OSHA, and VA requirements. Documentation and reporting of maintenance activities. Requested Information Interested vendors are requested to submit the following information: Company Information Company name Address Point of Contact Telephone number Email address UEI Number SAM.gov registration status Business Classification Identify all applicable socioeconomic designations: Small Business Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) HUBZone Small Business 8(a) Business Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) Large Business Capability Statement Provide a capability statement that addresses the following: Experience providing hospital bed rental services for hospitals, medical centers, or healthcare systems. Experience providing preventive and corrective maintenance services on hospital beds. Ability to support multiple facilities across the State of Texas. Available inventory of hospital beds and specialty beds. Delivery and response capabilities, including emergency services. Quality control procedures. Staffing and technical qualifications. Relevant past performance information from the previous five years. Contract Information Provide examples of recent contracts of similar size and scope, including: Contract Number Customer Name Contract Value Period of Performance Brief Description of Services North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) The Government is considering the following NAICS Code: NAICS 621610 Home Health Care Services, Vendors are encouraged to identify any alternative NAICS codes they believe may be more appropriate for this requirement. Responses Responses shall be submitted electronically no later than: December 10, 2026 11:00 AM Central Standard Time (CST) Submit responses via email to: Francisco Mendoza Contracting Officer Email: Francisco.Mendoza@va.gov The subject line should state: "RFI Response Hospital Bed Rental and Maintenance Services" Questions Interested parties may submit questions regarding this RFI via email. Responses to questions may be provided at the Government's discretion. Disclaimer This Request for Information is issued solely for market research purposes pursuant to RFO Part 10 and RFO 5.3. This is not a Solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI or otherwise pay for information submitted in response to this notice. Responses are voluntary and will not be returned. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents in developing its acquisition strategy and determining the appropriate procurement approach, including set-aside decisions. Participation in this market research effort is strongly encouraged; however, participation is not a prerequisite for participation in any future solicitation.

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Objective 5: Integrated Test and Diagnostics: The DIFS shall incorporate built-in test capabilities to generate, capture, and analyze Digital IF streams to allow for rapid troubleshooting, performance verification (e.g., Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) & spectral purity), and subsystem health monitoring with minimal operational burden and with on-site test equipment. Objective 6: Resilient and Maintainable Design (Resilient): The commercial solution shall be designed for high availability Ai ? 0.9998) a long service life (15 years), and rapid maintainability (MTTR ? 30 minutes), using standard line-replaceable items (LRIs). Objective 7: Secure and Compliant Architecture (Secure): The subsystem design shall be capable of achieving a Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization for a security categorization of (Confidentiality, Moderate), (Integrity, Moderate), (Availability, Moderate). title: Field Consultant & Operations Technical Support (FCOTS)
description: IMPORTANT NOTE: THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. REQUESTS FOR A SOLICITATION WILL NOT RECEIVE A RESPONSE. This Request for Information (RFI) is in support of Market Research being conducted by the United States Census Bureau (USCB) to gather general information and explore potential available solutions to support the agency�s need. This is not a Request for Proposal/Request for Quote or an indication that a contractual commitment will exist for this requirement. The Government does not intend to award a contract solely on the basis of this market research. No funds are necessarily obligated for any requirement or solicitation that may or may not ultimately arise from the results of this market research. The purpose of this tentative requirement is to promptly onboard expertise to support the Regional and Decennial infrastructure required to conduct large scale, time sensitive field operations. This includes the technical support needed to implement new training for Field operations and the systems that support hiring, training, pay and data collection efforts and the resulting analysis. This contract vehicle will provide support for current surveys, Decennial Census data collection, and geographic operations, including pre-2030 Decennial Census tests and objectives. A large portion of the support to assist in opening over 90 temporary offices from which hiring, training, coordinating material distribution, data collection, and payroll efforts will be administered or managed. Securing those office leases requires multiple staff with the knowledge and expertise to negotiate and secure lease and equipment agreements, Federal Protective Services, HVAC needs, space buildout, supplies, electrical, and network setup, this includes receiving equipment deliveries, setting up, and managing these temporary spaces the same as our permanent government spaces. Ultimately, Field Division must dismantle the infrastructure and release staff as promptly as they were secured. Contractual support staff are ideal for these monumental efforts. The services will be provided via the issuance of fixed price, time and material, or a combination of both call order types will enable FLD to obtain contractual support for divisions and program offices at Headquarters (HQ) to support the Census mission. The Contractor shall provide the services listed in Task Area 1 through 17 under Agreement Requirements. These Task Areas include but are not limited to; assisting in technical and operational writing, automated training development, infrastructure, recruiting, space planning, personnel and payroll, training development, training delivery, scheduling, training support, help desk support, SharePoint support, database engineering and administration, analytical and quantitative analysis.

This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Objective 5: Integrated Test and Diagnostics: The DIFS shall incorporate built-in test capabilities to generate, capture, and analyze Digital IF streams to allow for rapid troubleshooting, performance verification (e.g., Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) & spectral purity), and subsystem health monitoring with minimal operational burden and with on-site test equipment. Objective 6: Resilient and Maintainable Design (Resilient): The commercial solution shall be designed for high availability Ai ? 0.9998) a long service life (15 years), and rapid maintainability (MTTR ? 30 minutes), using standard line-replaceable items (LRIs)

title: Mesh and Hydrodynamic Framework for Shellfish Water Classification Program
description: This solicitation aims to collect and organize physical oceanographic data into a usable format for Environment and Climate Change Canada. The data will support the development of accurate hydrodynamic models to predict fecal coliform contamination in coastal and intertidal areas during both planned and unplanned events. These models and frameworks will enable ECCC Shellfish Water Classification Program (ECCC-SWCP) Engineers to evaluate potential water quality conditions in shellfish harvest waters near possible sanitary pollution sources. The information generated from this project will support the ECCC delivery of a wastewater assessment and hydrodynamic modelling to inform shellfish harvesters on sanitary pollution contamination.

Repair Turnaround Time (RTAT) definition: The contractual delivery requirementis measured from asset Return to the date of asset acceptance under the terms of the contract. For purposes of this section, return is defined as physical receiptof the F-condition asset at the contractor?s facility as reflected in the Action Dateentry in the commercial Asset Visibility (CAV) system. In accordance with the CAVStatement of Work, the contractor is required to accurately report all transactions by the end of the fifth regular business day after receipt and the Action Date entered in CAV must be dated to reflect the actual date of physical receipt. The Contractor must obtain final inspection and acceptance by the Government for all assets within the RTATs established in the subsequent contract. Throughput Constraint: Contractor must provide a throughput Constraint for each NSN(s). Total assets to be repaired monthly after initial delivery commences X/month (contractor fill in #). Reconciliation: A reconciliation modification will be issued after final Inspection and acceptance of all assets inducted under the subsequent contract. The parties have agreed to a price (shown on the schedule page of the contract) for each unit at the negotiated RTAT. Such prices are based on the Contractor meeting the RTAT requirements described within the schedule page. If the Contractor does not meet the applicable RTAT requirement, consideration will be assessed and subject to negotiation. Induction Expiration Date: 365 days after contract award date. Any asset received after this date in days is not authorized for repair without bi-lateral agreement between the Contractor and NAVSUP WSS Contracting Officer

title: Northern Research Station Irvine Lab Snow Plowing and Ice Removal
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1240BE27Q0022 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for snow and ice removal at the Northern Research Station Irvine Lab in Irvine, Pennsylvania. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 561730 The small business size standard is $9.5 mil. This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. See Attachment 1 - Performance Work Statement for a complete list of requirements. There will be an informal site visit on December 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET. No RSVP is necessary. All questions shall be submitted to Andrea Pollock at andrea.pollock@usda.gov but December 4, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET. An amendment will be posted to provide all quoters the questions and answers.
